title: Conversion of One Solid into Another — Surface Areas and Volumes
hook: Let's explore Conversion of One Solid into Another from the chapter on Surface Areas and Volumes. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Conversion of One Solid into Another When one solid is melted and recast into another shape, the volume remains the same. Set Volume₁ = Volume₂ to find unknown dimensions. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Volume is conserved when a solid is melted and reshaped
💡 Equate volumes: V(old shape) = V(new shape) or = n × V(each new)
💡 Common: sphere → cylinder, cone → spheres, cylinder → cones
💡 Number of new objects = Volume(original) / Volume(one new object)
